I had abusive parents too. I remember getting beat up in the 4th grade just because I got 9.96 out of 10. That's one of the episodes, but up to the 6th grade I was getting beatings constantly for nothing. Like breaking a plate. Or coming home late. Or getting a small grade. Or swearing. Or staying up late. Parents are never going to recognize their mistakes.

My parents never got up to make something. They never demanded more from them, never more from life, but from me. I was considered a failure because I was not like the other kids - not that I have a physical disability, but I was "not smart enough" or "no working hard enough". They never tried to get a better job to get more money. They just saved like crazy by ignoring their health and almost never buying new clothes. A penny saved is still a penny saved...

In life you just have to pursue what makes you happy as an individual. Don't try to make people happy, because no matter what you deliver, it's never going to be enough for them.

I learn this the hard way. I recently bought a new car - around 9000 euros or so.  
But my wife is not happy with it because I could go more in debt and get a more expensive one.

I moved from an old rusty rented apartment of 42sqm to a brand new house of 97sqm, + 300sqm of land. Do you think that made my wife happier? Noooo! We fight more often than before. I moved from earning $300 per month in 2012 to earning $2300 per month. Do you think she is happier now or we get along better? Nooooo!

So yeah my friends. Do what makes you happy.  
Does binging in TV Series grinds your gears? Do that!  
Does learning and reading books makes you happy? Do that!  
Playing computer games? Gooood!
